HP/KV/767

31st March 1942

Dear Mrs. Buxton,

Stanislas RETZLAW alias GROEHL

On behalf of Commander Senter I acknowledge with thanks receipt of the paper relating to the above named.

Yours sincerely,

H. E. Lark

Pilot Officer.

Mrs. E. Buxton,
M.I.5.
LONDON.
